Claude Desktop is a separate native workspace with its own appearance and controls. Aura will open Anthropic’s current guide. Aura will not choose or transfer your Remote Control session, send a project path or prompt, or style Claude Desktop. If your setup supports /desktop, run it yourself in the intended CLI session.
